meaning.en: CEE 7/5 socket (Type E, French socket with a protruding earth pin), shown as the socket face seen from the front, earth pin up
meaning.de: CEE-7/5-Steckdose (Typ E, französische Steckdose mit Erdungsstift), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn, Erdungsstift oben

standard.source: CEE 7/5 (NF C 61-314) not consulted; contact layout taken from the OpenPlugDB front view "CEE 7/5 socket-outlet (female holes, male earth pin), mating face, earth pin up" (https://github.com/ovarilo/openplugdb/blob/main/public/images/connectors/cee-7-type-e/cee-7-5-socket-front.svg, retrieved 2026-11-08), drawn from Wikipedia "AC power plugs and sockets" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_power_plugs_and_sockets, retrieved 2026-11-08); WorldStandards "Plug type E" (https://www.worldstandards.eu/electricity/plugs-and-sockets/e/, retrieved 2026-11-08)
